argv:
set -u
printf 'SECTION 6d-targeted\n'
for f in /var/tmp/afs-managed-package-6d51aeb.tar.gz /var/tmp/afs-off-6d-20261007-r1/package/afs-0.1.0-g2-procfree-6d51aeb-linux-aarch64/manifest.json /var/tmp/afs-off-6d-20261007-r1/prefix/manifest.json /var/tmp/afs-off-6d-20261007-r1/prefix/bin/afs-meta /var/tmp/afs-off-6d-20261007-r1/prefix/bin/afs-node; do
  printf 'PATH %s\n' "$f"
  if test -e "$f"; then
    ls -ld "$f"
    if test -f "$f"; then sha256sum "$f"; fi
    case "$f" in *.json) cat "$f" ;; esac
  else
    echo MISSING
  fi
done
printf 'SECTION dfs-statfs-runtime-targeted\n'
for f in /var/tmp/afs-dfs-statfs-runtime-20261007-r2/prefix/bin/afs-meta /var/tmp/afs-dfs-statfs-runtime-20261007-r2/prefix/bin/afs-node /var/tmp/afs-dfs-statfs-runtime-20261007-r2/drivers/standard.py /var/tmp/afs-dfs-statfs-runtime-20261007-r2/results/std-01-pjdfstest-full/artifacts/std-01-pjdfstest/proof.json /var/tmp/afs-dfs-statfs-runtime-20261007-r2/results/std-02-ltp-smoke6/artifacts/std-02-ltp/proof.json; do
  printf 'PATH %s\n' "$f"
  if test -e "$f"; then
    ls -ld "$f"
    if test -f "$f"; then sha256sum "$f"; fi
  else
    echo MISSING
  fi
done
printf 'SECTION ltp-smoke6-binaries\n'
for name in open01 read01 write01 stat01 chmod01 fcntl14; do
  f="/var/tmp/afs-e2e-20261006-r1/suites/ltp/testcases/bin/$name"
  printf 'PATH %s\n' "$f"
  if test -x "$f"; then ls -l "$f"; sha256sum "$f"; else echo MISSING_OR_NOT_EXECUTABLE; fi
done
printf 'SECTION pjdfstest-targeted\n'
cd /var/tmp/afs-e2e-20261006-r1/suites/pjdfstest 2>/dev/null && {
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git status --short
  test -x ./pjdfstest && sha256sum ./pjdfstest
  find tests -type f | wc -l
} || echo PJDFSTEST_DIR_MISSING
printf 'SECTION ltp-targeted\n'
cd /var/tmp/afs-e2e-20261006-r1/suites/ltp 2>/dev/null && {
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git status --short | head -80
  test -x ./runltp && sha256sum ./runltp
} || echo LTP_DIR_MISSING
